answers.reason: The full professor holds a chair but is not mentioned as a member of the senate.
The budget planning round is managed by the university leadership, not by full professors.
As a professor holding a chair in the faculty, they are a primary candidate for participation in appointment committees.
Faculty matters and councils typically include professors of the faculty.
Professors participate in teaching and study-related commissions of their faculty.
Examination boards deal with student examination matters typically handled or overseen by faculty members.
As a research group leader, the full professor is eligible for internal research funding evaluation.
Professors are responsible for their degree program modules and can participate in revision groups.
Laboratory equipment procurement directly concerns the research group leader.
Orientation week planning is generally handled by students or administrative staff.
